auto_controls.description: Let the model derive the edit conditioning schedule from the source video. Cannot be combined with edit_strength.
auto_controls.title: Auto Controls

controls.description: Per-signal conditioning controls (pose, depth, normals, trajectory, face) for finer control than edit_strength. Cannot be combined with auto_controls.

edit_strength.description: How closely the edit preserves the source video. 'adhere_*' stays closest to the source, 'flex_*' is balanced, and 'reimagine_*' diverges most. Leave unset to use Luma's default. Cannot be combined with auto_controls.
edit_strength.title: Edit Strength

exr_export.description: Also export an EXR file alongside the MP4. Requires hdr=true and HDR access.
exr_export.title: Exr Export

hdr.description: Generate an HDR-encoded MP4. Requires HDR access on the account and a resolution of 720p or 1080p.
hdr.title: Hdr

keyframe_indexes.description: Source-video frame positions where each keyframes[i] is anchored. Non-negative, unique, and the same length as keyframes.
keyframe_indexes.title: Keyframe Indexes

keyframes.description: Multi-keyframe edit guide frames: up to 64 image URLs pinned at the source-frame positions given by keyframe_indexes. Mutually exclusive with start_image_url. Provide keyframes and keyframe_indexes together (same length).
keyframes.title: Keyframes

prompt.description: Text prompt describing how to edit the source video.
examples: Restyle the footage as a hand-painted watercolor animation with soft pastel colors.
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Resolution of the edited video. Higher resolutions cost more.
resolution.title: Resolution

start_image_url.description: Optional URL of an image to use as the edited video's first frame — e.g. a restyled version of the source's opening frame to steer the look of the edit. Leave unset to let the model derive the first frame from the source video.
start_image_url.title: Start Image Url

video_url.description: URL of the source video to edit.
video_url.title: Video Url

exr_file.description: The generated EXR sidecar when exr_export is true. This may be a single EXR file or a ZIP package depending on Luma's export shape.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

RayEditControls.description:
Per-signal conditioning controls for ray-3.2 video editing.

Each signal is optional; include only the signals you want to tune. Cannot
be combined with auto_controls. Mirrors the Luma Agents ``video.edit.controls``
object — see https://docs.agents.lumalabs.ai/api/resources/generations.
RayEditControls.title: RayEditControls

blur.description: Depth blur. Higher values allow more geometric freedom. Leave unset for the default.
blur.title: Blur

enabled.description: Enable depth / scene-geometry conditioning for the edit.
enabled.title: Enabled

enabled.description: Enable face-identity conditioning for the edit.
enabled.title: Enabled

augmentation.description: Surface-normals augmentation. Higher values allow more reinterpretation of surface geometry. Leave unset for the default.
augmentation.title: Augmentation

enabled.description: Enable surface-normals conditioning for the edit.
enabled.title: Enabled

enabled.description: Enable pose / skeleton conditioning for the edit.
enabled.title: Enabled

strength.description: Pose conditioning precision. 'precise' follows the source pose tightly; 'coarse' allows more freedom. Leave unset for the default.
strength.title: Strength

enabled.description: Enable motion-trajectory conditioning for the edit.
enabled.title: Enabled

sparsity.description: Motion-trajectory sparsity. Higher values use fewer motion anchors. Leave unset for the default.
sparsity.title: Sparsity
